title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 11662 Gravois Road in St. Louis, Missouri, as the "Lt. Daniel P. Riordan Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 11662 Gravois Road in St. Louis, Missouri, as the "Lt. Daniel P. Riordan Post Office."

summary.headline: Names a St. Louis, Missouri post office building after Lt. Daniel P. Riordan.
summary.what_it_does: This law officially renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 11662 Gravois Road in St. Louis, Missouri, as the "Lt. Daniel P. Riordan Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office runs, what services it offers, or who works there.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 5, 2015, and the name took effect on that date.
